_README: PI / research-leadership status and current group page for Clevers-group alumni. One targeted web search per person. 'lead_type' is 'academic_pi' when a source shows the person heads a named academic group, lab or department; 'industry_lead' when they head a company or a research function in one (CEO, CRO, Global Head of R&D, Managing Director Research); null when neither. 'pi' stays true only for academic group leadership, so the two can be counted separately. 'clevers_trainee' is false for people who already led their own group independently of this lab. Keys match author_key (surname + first initial) in scripts/build_docs.py.
